messages:
Lara: Heads-up 1: UX review for a few tricky tie-breaker & preview interactions in the Rules editor. Prototype: https://www.figma.com/file/unique/tiebreaker-timeline. Can we review ordering affordances, undo behavior, and how preview highlights rules? @Jon @Priya @Zoe
Lara: Problem: PMs keep asking why a rule moved after a policy sync. They lose context. Idea: show a compact "tie-breaker timeline" in the preview panel that lists recent order changes (who/when) and why (manual / pin / api).
Jon: Timeline + compact diff is great. Make entries readable: "Mar 23, 09:12  Zoe changed priority -> set to 10 (pinned)". Also include a tiny "replay" affordance to highlight that rule in the list.
Priya: Microcopy: for timeline entries use active voice and a short action hint: e.g., "Zoe pinned rule to keep it above peers. Undo". The inline Undo should be keyboard accessible and time-limited (6s).
Zoe: For tie-breaker visuals I prefer a left colored stripe + tiny ordinal (#3) rather than heavy badges. Badges add noise. Stripe color semantics: blue=manual, purple=api, gold=pinned. Tooltips reveal full reason.
Jon: Accessibility: timeline items must be in a live region (aria-live="polite") so screen readers announce incoming remote changes. Also provide a condensed announcement when multiple changes arrive: "3 ordering changes detected" with a link to open timeline.
Priya: Validation/preview UX: instead of a global toast for preview errors, put an inline neutral pill on the rule row: "Preview: failed (details)". Pills should be focusable and open the detail flyout with more logs. Keeps context and is less disruptive.
Lara: Undo model: propose per-rule ephemeral undo stack (last action only). Show inline "Undo" and also put a non-modal history entry in the timeline. We should persist timeline for 24 hours and let users reopen it.
Zoe: Edge case: when priority numbers tie and a pinned rule is above an unpinned peer, the preview should clearly mark that as "pinned tiebreak" in the stripe tooltip. Add a subtle padlock icon next to the ordinal when pinned.
Jon: Drag behavior: don't make the entire row draggable. Use a dedicated handle with role="button" aria-label="Reorder rule" and support keyboard reordering mode (activate with Space -> then ArrowUp/Down). When in keyboard mode set aria-grabbed="true" and announce position updates "Moved to 2 of 8".
Priya: Copy for empty timeline: "No ordering changes yet. Pin a rule to keep its position, or open the audit log to view historical updates." Add CTA to the audit log.
Lara: Contrast check: design-bot, run the prototype quick scan on stripe colors + ordinal text at 12px. We don't want to fail AA.
design-bot: Automated contrast scan: gold pinned stripe text fails AA at 12px (id: stripe-07). Recommend ordinals use #ffffff on gold background, or change gold to #c38a00. Also flagged timeline entry timestamps under 13px as low contrast.
Zoe: Good catch. We'll switch ordinal to white on colored stripes and bump timeline text to 13px. Also make sure the padlock icon has an accessible name: aria-label="Pinned" and toggle-able via keyboard.
Jon: Preview performance: rapid sample switches leave stale highlights. Eng suggestion: attach a request-id to each preview run, cancel inflight fetch, and ignore out-of-order responses by checking response id. Debounce 200ms on sample switch.
Priya: Also add localization notes: timeline phrases must be short; some languages expand a lot. Keep action verbs first: "Pinned rule" instead of "Rule was pinned by" and use a separate detail line for agent/time.
Lara: Action items: 1) Zoe: update prototype with stripes, padlock, and timeline mock + white ordinals. 2) Priya: push timeline + undo microcopy and localization guidance. 3) Jon: write a11y spec for handle, keyboard reorder, aria-live timeline, and request-id suggestion for preview. 4) I'll add a quick Figma flow for the replay/highlight affordance. Review next Wednesday.
Priya: I'll include the 6s inline Undo behavior and the persistent 24h timeline retention in copy docs.
Zoe: I'll also include a mobile fallback: long-press on a row opens an actions sheet with Pin/Move/Details so no hover dependence.
Lara: Thanks all! :thumbsup: We'll validate contrast after Zoe updates.
